title: Stepper DOM wiring is executed by no automated test, and the header's claimed bug-hunt E2E coverage is backed by no committed scenario
detail: AC 'new behavior covered (step navigation, validation gating per step, fallback path)' is met only at decision-logic level. Unpinned: Back/Continue click→show/hide, markInvalid rendering, preflight hold, form.js-probe bail (form_stepper.js:232), missing-form/<2-section no-op guards. `grep -rn "step-continue|step-back-|form_stepper|stepper-progress" .claude/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/` returns 0 matches; the comment is also stale — anchor routing is now unit-pinned via resolveAnchorTarget tests.
recommended_fix: Record the DOM-glue deferral in deferred-work.md (mirroring the apply_analytics entry) and correct the header claim, or commit one bug-hunt scenario driving step-continue/step-back on /apply/:code.

title: Header's documented run command `node --test scripts/js-tests/` fails on the repo's Node (v22.22.0); only the glob form works
evidence:
// Unit tests for server/priv/static/form_stepper.js — run with
// `node --test scripts/js-tests/` (wired into `make test` as test-js).
detail: Running that exact command exits 1 with "Cannot find module '…/scripts/js-tests'" (verified 3×, with/without trailing slash). Makefile:403 and package.json test:js use `node --test scripts/js-tests/*.test.js`, which passes 52/52 — so `make test` is green, but the comment sends devs to a broken invocation.
recommended_fix: Change the header comment to `node --test scripts/js-tests/*.test.js` (matching the Makefile and npm script).
